items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: Frank Sinatra copied his style after Tommy Dorsey.

ctx.x: Because I knew a musician that knew the band that did the audition for the club-owner, I think it must have been the Rusty Cabin, and the man that had the Rusty Cabin said, 'I'll take the band, but I don't want that singer.' And the guys were so together, they wouldn't take the job unless they took Frank Sinatra. Then Frank Sinatra got involved with the trombone player. And I actually think... Somebody just said of (?) who he gives credit for his style. But Frank Sinatra copied his style after Tommy Dorsey.…
Well, that's the band he made his big hit with, 'I'll Never Smile Again.'
